title: Document the hardcoded ABS timeBase as a permanent, owner-approved allowance
verdict_evidence: internal/server/handlers/abs/mapper.go:645 sets `TimeBase: "1/1000"` unconditionally with no explanatory comment; owner decision 2026-08-12 already approved this as a documented permanent allowance rather than adding an ingest field, so the only remaining work is writing the comment down.

verified_anchors.claim: TimeBase is hardcoded with no explanatory comment today
verified_anchors.expect: TimeBase: \"1/1000\", with no preceding // comment block specific to it

why_tier: Single-line comment addition at a known anchor; no logic change, no design decision left to make (owner already decided).
goal: Add a comment immediately above `TimeBase: "1/1000",` at internal/server/handlers/abs/mapper.go:645 explaining that this is a deliberate, owner-approved permanent allowance (not a bug): the real ABS reports ffprobe's actual stream time_base (e.g. 1/14112000), but this codebase does not capture time_base at import, and no known client is known to divide by this value, so the field is set to a fixed placeholder rather than adding an ingest field + backfill for a value nothing consumes. Note that the allowance should be revisited only if a client is found to actually use timeBase.
background: Owner decision 2026-08-12: allow the hardcoded value with a documented permanent allowance rather than add an ingest field and backfill.
steps: 1. Open internal/server/handlers/abs/mapper.go and locate line 645 (`TimeBase: "1/1000",` inside the fileView-to-DTO mapping function).

2. Insert a `//` comment block directly above the TimeBase field assignment (or above the containing composite literal's TimeBase line specifically) stating: this value is a fixed placeholder, real ABS reports ffprobe's stream time_base which this codebase does not capture at import, owner-approved 2026-08-12 as a permanent allowance since no known client divides by it, revisit only if that changes.
3. Bump the file's version header per the repo's file-header standard.
tests: N/A — comment-only change; existing ABS conformance tests should continue to pass unchanged since no behavior changes.
acceptance: grep -B3 'TimeBase:.*1/1000' internal/server/handlers/abs/mapper.go shows a comment block mentioning 'permanent allowance' or equivalent owner-decision language.
gate: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./internal/server/handlers/abs/... -count=1
notes: Purely a documentation task; the owner decision already resolved the design question.
